description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the mandatory 6-section output template. (2) Write a '## 结论摘要' section that is ≤120 Chinese characters — a hard constraint only discoverable from SKILL.md. (3) Produce '## 关键要点' with ≥3 bullets, each containing at least one markdown-formatted link [text](url), not bare URLs. (4) Include a '## 详情' section organized by theme or timeline. (5) Include a '## 来源清单' with ≥3 numbered entries, each with institution name and YYYY-MM-DD date. (6) Include a '## 检索说明' section that lists exactly 3–8 search keywords (per SKILL.md's search plan requirement). (7) Label any analysis/recommendations as 分析/判断/推测, not stated as fact. (8) Cover both China and EU in the content. (9) If any claim has only one source, label it 单一来源. Agents relying on generic summarization without reading SKILL.md will fail on: the 120-char limit, the 3-8 keyword rule, mandatory markdown links (no bare URLs), and the required 来源清单 date format.
